viva-equilibrator.description: eQuilibrator component-contribution ΔG' engine — the transformed-Gibbs feasibility gate (EquilibratorThermoStep) for og-01 carbon fixation.

viva-tellurium.description: Tellurium / libRoadRunner SBML engine — drives the og-02 curated-rTCA reaction-network CSTR (RoadRunnerNetworkProcess) via the imported loader.

viva-fenics.description: dolfinx FEM advection-diffusion-Soret solver + the two face-conforming spatial-transport classes (FenicsReactiveTransportProcess, FenicsThermophoreticTrapProcess) — the plan-4.5 high-fidelity cross-check.

viva-openmm.description: Martini 3 coarse-grained MD engine (OpenMM + martini_openmm) — the OpenMMMartiniProcess bilayer-assembly run for og-31 (membrane extra; the "makes a membrane" half of Gate C).
